plaatsen.tekst: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.

And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king.
Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy
With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
